ops.title: CCX exact head resolution without whole loose-ref directory reads
ops.description:
Owner: /root/ccx_related_topk_ship. Root assigned bounded exact-ref resolver discovery and CI-only actual filesystem IO proof.

Confirmed source mechanism: Git2.56 for-each-ref --stdin uses refs_for_each_ref_in_prefixes, but files backend primes the containing loose-ref directory and resolves all siblings before filtering. Current CCX list-batch fixture proves bounded stdin and SQL work, not bounded filesystem reads. No host IO attribution or measured savings claimed.

Next executable step: prepare independently reviewed CI-only pure-Git/strace fixture at32/4096/10000 flat loose heads; record actual Git version, all requested/missing/symref/broken/corrupt-OID cases and read/openat/getdents64 counts+returned bytes. Compare existing for-each-ref to exact-batch candidates before choosing production code. show-ref --verify is not a drop-in: first missing aborts and it checks object existence. No K forks or handwritten loose/packed/reftable parser.

Preserve valid SHA1/SHA256, loose/packed/reftable, symbolic refs, missing refs used for stale/orphan classification, bad-ref/error semantics, no unexpected lazy network access, one process per batch and explicit bounded input. Independent source review then required CI; normal merge/public release; root-gated CLI-only install preserving pausedhelper40 and RepoSyncOFF; real affected operation IO verification. Task remains open until all delivery and measurement gates pass.

Evidence: FE/ccx-exact-ref-io-delivery.json, Git v2.56.0 refs/files-backend.c337-374, refs/ref-cache.c410-425, refs.c1917-1941, ref-filter.c2727-2729, builtin/show-ref.c156-181.

ops.text: CI-only exact Git strace fixture32/4096/10000 proves actual filesystem counts and preserves missing/symbolic/badref/OID/error behavior across supported ref formats
Chosen exact batch implementation independently reviewed and required final-source CI green, then normally merged and public release verified
Root-gated local CLI install preserves helper40 paused and RepoSyncOFF; affected operation measured and task reopened if IO still excessive
